steps.title: Outer shape
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as seat_cover.ipt.
Sketch the side profile 450 deep, 82 high at the front and 52 at the back. Extrude 450 mm, Symmetric.
steps.note: The top of the cover at the front edge is the seat height: 440 mm.

steps.title: Hollow it
actions: Click Shell. Remove the bottom face. Thickness 2 mm, Inside. Save.
steps.note: A 2 mm skin: the wool blend face, the fire blocking layer and the stain resistant finish.
